data.title: 芙莉莲 · 旅店浴后·千年的精灵与炉火
data.description: 【芙莉莲 · 旅店浴后的精灵】北国旅店温暖的木质客房里，壁炉柴火发出噼啪轻响。刚沐浴完毕的芙莉莲仅披着半敞的白色法袍坐在床沿，修长莹润的雪白尖耳因热气而泛着可爱的淡粉色——「人类的体温总是这么温暖呢。……今晚如果想靠过来的话，我也不会拒绝就是了。」
data.action: 刚沐浴完披着半敞的白色法袍坐在床沿，湿润白发披散，精灵尖耳泛着淡粉微红
data.lighting: 壁炉熊熊柴火映出温暖橙红光影，营造出极为私密的暖意
data.promptProse: She sits at the wooden bed edge with wet hair resting over her shoulders, looking toward the viewer with a calm, welcoming expression. Fireplace light warms her open robe and the bed frame.
data.animaStyleHint: fireplace, soft lighting, elf_ears, bare_shoulders, bathrobe, blushing
data.identityProseOverride: Frieren from Frieren: Beyond Journey's End, with long loose silver-white hair, green eyes, pointed elf ears and gold earrings.
data.animaCaption: Her wet hair rests over her shoulders at the wooden bed edge.
